# Cavalli Tower

> Cavalli Tower is a luxury residential skyscraper of more than seventy storeys on the Al Sufouh waterfront in Dubai Media City, rising about 306 metres and facing Dubai Marina across the water. Interiors throughout are styled by the Roberto Cavalli house, making it the first residential tower to carry the brand. Amenities include sky gardens, infinity pools set roughly 90 and 220 metres above ground, an artificial beach with dining outlets and a four-storey lobby.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Media City, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

Cavalli Tower is a B+G+71 luxury residential tower by DAMAC Properties on the Dubai Media City waterfront overlooking Dubai Marina, rising around 306 metres with interiors by the Roberto Cavalli design house. MENASCO is delivering the complete MEP works across Shell & Core and high-end fit-out, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing and life-safety systems engineered for the coastal environment.
